item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Your morning meds are already anchored right after your routine, so this isn't about remembering — it's about not letting a busy day push it later and later until it's an afterthought. That's when doses get skipped. One action: take your diabetes meds and Praluent at 9, before anything else on the calendar competes for your attention.
